violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: meat sauce (46F) in walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Person in charge discarded meat sauce.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: cooked linguine and other pastas marked (5/15) in 1 door upright cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Person in charge discarded items.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored on cook line in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC placed all open drink containers in designated storage.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the service station being used to fill water glasses.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC discarded water and trained staff on proper use of hand sinks.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Clams have been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. PIC provided shellstock tag.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours. Marinara sauce (89-105F) at back prep table after 3.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded marinara.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinara sauce (71F) at cook line; minestrone (45F), cooked penne (47F) in 1 door upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC placed items to be cooled.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: hotel pans of marinara sauce left at ambient temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC trained staff on proper cooling procedures. ROCCO'S ITALIAN RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 11/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: dish machine observed with chlorine bleach concentration at 0 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted repair technician and set up three compartment sink for manual sanitization. PIC will provide documentation of repair to EHS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lasagna, cooked manicotti, cooked chicken patty observed between 43-48F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC stated that the foods had been moved to the unit 2 hours prior to the inspection. PIC moved the chicken, manicotti, and lasagna into the walk-in refrigerator for rapid cooling and discarded any items that had been held in the unit overnight.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 Door refrigerator near the cook line/stove is holding around 44-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The unit may be used during service to temporarily hold food items, but temperatures should be monitored to avoid temperature abuse of the foods. Avoid the Temperature Danger Zone (41f-135f).

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections at the mop sink are in disrepair and cannot be used.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair; please obtain plumbing repairs to the mop sink. Do not dump mop water outside, it must go down the drainage system/ wastewater basin, designed for contaminated water, that was approved and installed in the kitchen.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: FETTUCCINE (40F) WAS PREPARED ON 11/23/2024. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN TRUE 1-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: MARINARA SAUCE (40F) WAS PREPARED ON 11/30/2024 AND STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER (#1) FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM MARKED THE FOOD WITH PREPARATION DATE.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A HOSE ATTACHED TO THE MOP SINK WITHOUT A BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CFM DETACHED THE HOSE.
